content: The execution was successful (Reward 1.0) using a comprehensive Python-based HWPX manipulation strategy. Key success factors confirmed for this task type: 1) Extracting and modifying the XML directly (section0.xml), 2) Systematic date conversion from YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY.MM.DD, 3) Mapping Risk Tiers to Korean severity notes (e.g., High -> High (즉시조치)), 4) Removing all <lineSegArray> elements to prevent visual artifacts, and 5) Using the zipfile module to repackage the HWPX structure correctly. This pattern consistently solves HWPX automation tasks where template placeholders and specific formatting rules (dates, conditional text) are required.
